notes: Scope strictly per task card: ONLY the task-bound independent watchdog — no routine/cron/workflow-template code, no profiles provisioned, no services restarted. The watchdog is deliberately NOT an auto-fixer: its whole decision surface is firing the independent reviewer (event with reviewer + instructions) and applying that reviewer's verdict through the four non-repair verbs. Sticky escalation routes to triage (the established recurrence-routing pattern) and freezes the watchdog — only a human removes it; no path re-opens a human gate. The dispatcher tick integration is the minimal safe shape: flag-gated (default off, byte-identical ticks when off), fail-open, after the lanes, exactly once per tick.
